cards.text: It's the day after Jesus fed that huge crowd. The people still on that side of the sea notice something strange: only one boat was there, the disciples left in it alone, and Jesus never got on. Then some boats from Tiberias land nearby.

cards.question: The crowd sees that Jesus and His disciples are both gone. Where do they take the boats to look for Him?

cards.text: They find Jesus on the other side of the sea and ask, "Rabbi, when did You get here?" That's the face you make when the last bus left WITHOUT your coworker, and somehow he's at his desk before you.

cards.question: Jesus skips the when and goes straight to the why. Why does He say the crowd is looking for Him?

answers.text: They ate the loaves and had their fill
They saw Him walking on the sea
They want Him to heal their sick

cards.text: Then Jesus tells them not to work for food that perishes. Friend, I know ALL about food that perishes. My best batch of the week? Stale by Thursday.

cards.question: Instead, Jesus says to work for food that endures to ___ life, which the Son of Man will give.

cards.text: Jesus adds that God the Father has placed His seal of approval on the Son of Man. Then the crowd asks Him, "What must we do to perform the works of God?"

cards.question: The crowd asks Jesus what they must do to perform the works of God. What does He say the work of God is?

answers.text: To believe in the One He has sent
To keep every command of the law
To give to everyone in need

cards.text: Now they ask Jesus what sign He'll perform so they can see it and believe Him. Friend, these folks ate miracle bread YESTERDAY, and today they want to know what ELSE He's got.

cards.question: To make their point, the crowd brings up what their fathers ate in the wilderness. What was it?

cards.text: They even quote Scripture about it: "He gave them bread from heaven to eat." Then Jesus starts in with "Truly, truly, I tell you," and friend, when He says it twice, you LEAN in.

cards.question: Jesus says it was Moses who gave them the bread from heaven.

cards.text: Jesus says it's His Father who gives the true bread from heaven, and the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world. My best batch EVER fed one block party.
The crowd is IN: "Sir," they say, "give us this bread at all times." And Jesus answers, "I am the bread of life."

cards.question: Jesus says whoever comes to Him will never ___, and whoever believes in Him will never ___.

cards.text: But Jesus tells them, "you have seen Me and still you do not believe." Then, friend, He turns right around and makes a PROMISE about everyone the Father gives Him.

cards.question: Jesus promises He will never drive away the one who comes to Him.

cards.text: Jesus says He came down from heaven, not to do His own will, but to do the will of Him who sent Him. Me? I hop into the storeroom for chocolate chips and come back out with an apron, a timer and NO chocolate chips.

cards.question: Jesus says the will of the One who sent Him is that He shall ___ none of those the Father has given Him, but ___ them up at the last day.
Jesus says it's His Father's will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and He will raise him up at the last day.

cards.text: We're still in Capernaum, where Jesus has said, "I am the bread that came down from heaven." Now the Jews there start to GRUMBLE about Him, and friend, after years in the back of a junk drawer, I know that sound.

cards.question: The grumblers can't see how Jesus came down from heaven. What do they point to?

answers.text: They know His father and mother

cards.text: Friend, you can run a whole company, and back home you're STILL just somebody's kid. Jesus' reply is short: "Stop grumbling among yourselves."

cards.question: Jesus says no one can come to Him unless the Father who sent Him draws him, and He will raise him up at the last day.

cards.text: Jesus quotes the Prophets: "And they will all be taught by God." Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Jesus, and friend, that's learning that LANDS, unlike the online class I quit after the welcome video.

cards.question: Jesus says no one has seen the Father except the One who is from God.

cards.text: Another "Truly, truly, I tell you" from Jesus, and by now I'm leaning in so far I'm about to tip right off my base: he who believes has eternal life. And He says that line again: "I am the bread of life."

cards.question: Jesus says their fathers who ate the manna in the wilderness never died.
Then Jesus points to the bread that comes down from heaven. He says anyone may eat of it and not ___.

cards.text: Then Jesus says it plain: "I am the living bread that came down from heaven." And He says the bread He will give for the life of the world is His flesh.

cards.question: Jesus says if anyone eats of this living bread, how long will he live?

cards.text: The Jews start arguing among themselves: "How can this man give us His flesh to eat?" Friend, I shared a junk drawer with dead batteries that argued for YEARS about who had the most charge left.

cards.question: Jesus doesn't back down. What does He say about anyone who doesn't eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man?

answers.text: They have no life in them

cards.text: Jesus says whoever eats His flesh and drinks His blood has eternal life, and He will raise him up at the last day: "For My flesh is real food, and My blood is real drink." He doesn't soften a single word, friend, and me? One baker frowns at my cookies and I'm rewriting the WHOLE recipe.

cards.question: What else does Jesus say about whoever eats His flesh and drinks His blood?

answers.text: He remains in Jesus and Jesus in him
He sees the Father face to face
He rules the land with Jesus

cards.text: Just as the living Father sent Jesus and He lives because of the Father, Jesus says the one who feeds on Him will live because of Him. Friend, I lose my train of thought between the dough and the oven, but Jesus comes ALL the way back to the manna: the fathers ate it and died, but whoever eats THIS bread will live forever.

cards.question: Jesus said all this while teaching in the ___ in Capernaum.

cards.text: I bet that room had a LOT to chew on. Hang on, friend. This story isn't done yet.
